description: This file implements a local cache layer for emoji data in the Mattermost server, including cache invalidation, retrieval, and deletion methods.

classes.name: LocalCacheEmojiStore
classes.description: A cache layer for emoji data with invalidation and retrieval methods.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateEmojiById
methods.description: Handles invalidation messages for emoji cache by ID.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateEmojiIdByName
methods.description: Handles invalidation messages for emoji cache by name.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an emoji by ID, using cache if allowed, otherwise querying the store.

methods.name: GetByName
methods.description: Retrieves an emoji by name, using cache if allowed, otherwise querying the store.

methods.name: GetMultipleByName
methods.description: Retrieves multiple emojis by their names, utilizing cache when possible.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes an emoji and removes it from cache.

methods.name: addToCache
methods.description: Adds an emoji to the cache.

methods.name: getFromCacheById
methods.description: Retrieves an emoji from cache by ID.

methods.name: getFromCacheByName
methods.description: Retrieves an emoji from cache by name.
